subject: Windows reins in AI agents 🖥️, Optimizely spreads malware 🚨, Snowflake opens data sharing ❄️

stories.headline: SAP completes acquisition of TechWolf; it joins the SAP SuccessFactors portfolio
stories.description: Talent and work intelligence, joining SAP SuccessFactors portfolio

facts.text: TechWolf becomes part of the SAP SuccessFactors portfolio
facts.quote:
TechWolf will become part of the SAP SuccessFactors portfolio to
support talent and work intelligence strategies.

stories.headline: Microsoft announces new Windows controls for AI agents, including process containers and micro VMs
stories.quote:
Microsoft announced new Windows controls for AI agents, including
preview improvements to process containers and experimental
hardware-isolated micro VMs.

facts.text: Learning modes are generally available; Intune previews automatic updates for employee-installed applications
facts.quote:
Generally available learning modes let IT
observe agent behavior before enforcing restrictions, while Intune is
previewing automatic updates for applications employees install
themselves.

stories.headline: Optimizely breach spread malicious JavaScript through websites of at least 178 organizations
stories.quote:
Attackers exploited Optimizely's experimentation software to
distribute malicious JavaScript through websites belonging to at least
178 organizations.

facts.text: Payloads targeted cryptocurrency wallets and payment details
facts.quote:
The payloads targeted cryptocurrency wallets and
payment details.

facts.text: Optimizely says it patched the vulnerability, removed injected code and revoked tokens
facts.quote:
Optimizely says it patched the vulnerability, removed
injected code, and revoked tokens.

stories.headline: Microsoft and Salesforce announce integrations connecting Salesforce with Copilot, Teams and Fabric
stories.quote:
Microsoft and Salesforce announced integrations connecting Salesforce
with Copilot, Teams, and Fabric.

facts.text: A Copilot plugin is in public preview with more than 38 sales skills
facts.quote:
A Copilot plugin is available in
public preview with more than 38 sales skills

stories.headline: Microsoft introduces impersonation protection for Teams meetings and calls
stories.quote:
Microsoft is introducing new capabilities to combat social
engineering and impersonation across Teams meetings and calls.

stories.headline: Snowflake launches Open Data Sharing for Apache Iceberg tables without a Snowflake account
stories.quote:
Snowflake has launched Open Data Sharing, enabling data providers to
share Apache Iceberg tables with external consumers using Iceberg REST
Catalog-compatible clients without requiring a Snowflake account or
scheduled data exports.
